name: Real-Debrid sign-in
description: Signs a Real-Debrid account in with a code, and keeps the sign-in renewed.

codes.realdebrid_auth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at Real-Debrid.
codes.realdebrid_auth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Press Connect again.
codes.realdebrid_auth.sign_in_refused: Real-Debrid no longer accepts this sign-in. Connect the account again.
codes.realdebrid_auth.two_factor: Real-Debrid asked for two-factor authentication. Confirm it there and start the sign-in again.
codes.realdebrid_auth.client_rejected: Real-Debrid no longer accepts the client this sign-in was issued. Connect the account again.
codes.realdebrid_auth.bad_reply: Real-Debrid sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.realdebrid_auth.redirect_unsupported: Real-Debrid signs in with a device code and has no redirect.
codes.realdebrid_auth.rate_limited: Real-Debrid is receiving too many requests right now. Try connecting again in a minute.
